correctness.rationale: The M-bit history chain is irreducible and aperiodic with its verified exchangeable invariant law. For fixed M, bounded martingale innovation epsilon_t=Z_t-rho-a sum_(j=1)^M(Z_(t-j)-rho) has variance rho(1-rho)D_M/(1+Mdelta)^2. Its predictable quadratic variation obeys the ergodic theorem; the martingale functional CLT and a pathwise uniform O_M(N) weighted-sum difference prove convergence in D[0,1]. The exact covariance kernel follows by Ito isometry. The independent finite-state rational Poisson-equation checker passed 402 assertions for 12 Markov kernels, M=1..4. No finite evidence is treated as proof of the infinite claim.
